##### Project general facts

The Willows Residences is a limited-edition boutique development by SCC Vertex, conceived as a low-rise residential retreat within a low-density community. The building offers one- and two-bedroom apartments in two series, The Sculpted for compact, efficient living and The Cultivated with larger layouts and closed-kitchen options in select two-bedroom homes, along with retail units at ground level. Many apartments enjoy views towards the Burj Khalifa skyline or the greenery of Al Barari, combining calm surroundings with a strong connection to the city.

Amenities are designed around mindful living, fitness and relaxation. An elevated rooftop pool deck includes shallow and lounge areas, alongside a rooftop lounge for unwinding with open views. Residents have a naturally lit gym with modern equipment, a tranquil yoga space and a landscaped building garden for quiet strolls. Families benefit from a safe play area for children, while in-building shops and cafes add everyday convenience. A building concierge and a CCTV-based security system with round-the-clock monitoring complete the offer.

Interiors feature high ceilings, expansive floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows, large-format flooring and recessed LED lighting. Principal bedrooms include walk-in closets with built-in organisers. Kitchens are fitted with premium appliances, including a gas hob, built-in dishwasher and oven, quartz countertops, full-height pantries and under-cabinet lighting. Bathrooms offer floating vanities with soft-close hardware, wall-mounted WCs, polished chrome fixtures and frameless rain showers. Apartments are delivered with fitted kitchens and wardrobes, ready for the owner's own furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan South is part of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, a low-density neighbourhood of villas, townhouses and boutique apartment buildings. It sits close to the parks of Nad Al Sheba and the green landscapes of Al Barari, offering a calm residential environment with private community gardens and tree-lined streets. The wider Meydan community is known for its racecourse, golf course, cycling tracks and premium residential addresses.

The area provides easy access to major roads leading to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Business Bay, with Dubai International Airport also within comfortable reach. Global Village, Silicon Oasis Mall and the Al Barari forest are close by. Families are served by schools such as GEMS Wellington Academy, Lycée Libanais Francophone Privé Meydan and Indian International School, while Fakeeh University Hospital and Aster Clinic provide healthcare nearby.

Meydan is a freehold destination that attracts end users looking for space and privacy close to the city centre. Limited land availability and the low-density planning of the district support long-term value, while proximity to Downtown Dubai and Business Bay keeps rental demand steady among professionals and families. The area suits first-time buyers, growing families and investors seeking a quieter address with central connectivity.
